intro: Match each claim to the document detail that proves it. Name the document, then use the detail.

left.label: Hobbes thought life without a government would be terrible.
hints: Which detail describes life with no government?

left.label: Locke believed people could take power back from a bad government.
hints: Which detail says what happens to power when a government goes too far?

left.label: Montesquieu feared power held by one person.
hints: Which detail is about all the power in one person's hands?

left.label: Rousseau put the common good ahead of private wants.
hints: Which detail talks about the good of everyone together?

left.label: Wollstonecraft challenged the men who shut women out.
hints: Which detail is a challenge, not a request?

left.label: Catherine's government did not treat serfs as equals.
hints: Which detail shows how the government treated serfs?

right.label: Hobbes, Leviathan: without a power to keep them in awe, people live in a state of war.
Document 2: a legislature that grabs absolute power forfeits it, and the power passes back to the people.
Document 4: when the power to make and enforce laws sits with one person, there can be no liberty.
Document 6: the general will takes account only of the common interest.
Document 7: she dares them to prove first that women lack reason.
Document 10: serfs who complain about their landlords are to be whipped and sent to forced labor.

rationale.a: Hobbes says people with no common power over them live in a state of war. That proves he thought life without government would be terrible.
rationale.b: Document 2 says power passes back to the people when a legislature abuses it. That's the detail that proves the claim.
rationale.c: Document 4 says there can be no liberty when one person makes and enforces the laws. That's Montesquieu's fear, in his own argument.
rationale.d: Document 6 says the general will looks only at the common interest, not private wants. That proves the claim.
rationale.e: Document 7 dares lawmakers to prove women lack reason before shutting them out. The dare is the challenge.
rationale.f: Document 10 orders punishment for serfs who complain. That proves serfs weren't treated as equals.
